revisions.author: Susanto
revisions.description: [DB-R1] Database mapping revised to the ELIPS schema: KPI items = ielp.MS_KPI, score ranges = ielp.MS_KPI_PERCENTAGE, order sharing = ielp.CRITERIA_LAST_ORDER (per period); company KPI values, payment type and daily trip have no master table (conflicts / TBD); no sample data

objective: To maintain the performance value (Score, KPI items, Total, Grade) of each trucking company.
To maintain the Order Sharing per trucking company, used in the daily order assignment by the VPLD planner and as the daily QTY in PR creation.
To add KPI items (columns) and trucking companies (from Master Trucking Company), and to fill in the values directly in the grid.

To maintain By Resources and By Trip trucking companies with the same columns: Order Sharing % and Daily Trip. By Resources: Daily Trip typed (Order Sharing % information only). By Trip: Order Sharing % typed (total 100%), Daily Trip calculated from the trips per day (reference 20). Both are used by the DTP Creation slot monitoring.

operation.text: 5.1 Initial Display
Title 'Master KPI', breadcrumb 'Master - Master KPI' (menu Master > KPI).
Grid with all trucking companies; KPI item columns in their sequence with header colours; Total By Resource in the footer. No data: message no. 17.
Values are shown as plain numbers; Grade as a badge; Order Sharing highlighted.
5.2 Add / Delete KPI Item (KP-02, KP-03)

items: Add New: name required (no. 1), max 15 characters (no. 2), unique case-insensitive (no. 3).
The item is added as the last column with the next palette colour; value 0 for every company; Total unchanged. Message no. 4.
[x] on the header (hover): confirmation no. 5; delete the item and its values; Total recalculated; message no. 6.

operation.text: 5.3 Add Trucking Company (KP-01)

items: Select Trucking Company lists active companies of Master Trucking Company not yet in Master KPI (no. 7 / 8 / 9).
+ Add Company inserts the row: Payment Type 'By Resources', UoM 'Truck', Score / KPI values / Order Sharing 0; the row opens in Edit Mode (no. 10).

operation.text: 5.4 Grid Edit (KP-04, KP-10)

items: Start: Edit (✎) or click a number cell. Only one row at a time (no. 11).
Score, each KPI value and Order Sharing become input boxes; Total and Grade are recalculated while typing.
Save (✓ / Enter): Score 0-1000, KPI value 0-999, Order Sharing 0-99, whole numbers (no. 12, wrong cells red); version check (no. 13).
Success: update the row and its values, Changed Dt / By; refresh Total By Resource; message no. 14.

operation.text: 5.5 Calculations (KP-05 to KP-07)

rows: Sum of all KPI item values of the row
Sum of Order Sharing of rows with Payment Type 'By Resources'

operation.text: Example (reference): AGR 3 + DNX 4 + GIB 5 + JMP 4 + PBM 4 = Total By Resource 20.
5.6 Delete Trucking Company (KP-11)
Confirmation no. 15; delete the row and its values; message no. 16.
5.7 Use of Order Sharing (KP-08, KP-09)
Daily order assignment (VPLD planner): orders of the day are split in proportion to Order Sharing (largest remainder; ties by higher Total, then code). 20 orders with 3/4/5/4/4 = 3/4/5/4/4.
PR creation: the daily QTY of a trucking company = its Order Sharing.
5.8 Search, Kolom, Export XLS
Search filters on all visible columns; no match: message no. 18.
Kolom shows / hides fixed columns and KPI items; hidden values are kept when a row is saved.
Export XLS: all filtered rows, visible columns, numbers as numbers, plus a 'Total By Resource' line.
5.9 Security and Audit
Access follows the existing role framework (View / Add / Edit / Delete / Export Master KPI, TBD).
Audit: Created Dt / By, Changed Dt / By (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS); seeded data shows SYSTEM.
5.10 Payment Type By Trip (KP-01, KP-04, KP-14)
A company may have one By Resources row and one By Trip row (key Trucking Company + Payment Type). Same company and type again: message no. 19.

By Trip Order Sharing = % with max 2 decimals, 0-100 (message no. 20). Total By Trip must be 100.00%: not blocking, the bar turns red and the save message adds message no. 21. A By Trip row with 0% is not eligible.
Grade: GOLD from 666 (reference 667 GOLD, 665 SILVER), SILVER 600-665, BRONZE below 600 (TBD).
5.11 Order Sharing % and Daily Trip per payment type (KP-04, KP-07, KP-14..KP-16)

rows: Typed, 0-100, 2 decimals; information only (no effect on Daily Trip yet)
Calculated: trips per day shared by %, 1 per company first, rest by % (largest remainder)
Total Order Sharing %, Total Daily Trip (= Total By Resource)
Total Order Sharing %, Trips per day (input, default 20), Total Daily Trip

operation.text: Reference: 20 trips per day over 11 By Trip companies -> GIB, VMB, JMP, DNX, IBT, MJR, PLI, PNJ, PBM 2 each; AGR, PS 1 each (By Trip Daily Trip column).
Changing Trips per day or a By Trip % recalculates the By Trip Daily Trip of every row; the daily limits are used by DTP Creation vs Master KPI (KM-02, KM-09..KM-12).
The separate daily trip allocation table of rev 0.2 is removed: the allocation is the Daily Trip column.
Database Specification (ELIPS AE070_ILS_DB)

Source of truth for tables / columns / types: docs/db/ELIPS_Schema.sql. No sample data was available: value lists and status codes are TBD. Status: Verified = UISS already matched the schema; Revised = changed to the schema in this revision; Conflict = code / UISS rule not supported by the table; TBD = not confirmed.
Conflicts (UISS / code vs ELIPS schema) - application not changed

items: G-MKP-01 Per-company KPI master: UISS / code: KPI Master per trucking company (score, values, payment type, order sharing, daily trip). DB: Only MS_KPI (items) and period tables CRITERIA_SCORE_DETAIL / CRITERIA_LAST_ORDER. Recommendation: New master table or confirm the period tables are the source
G-MKP-02 Payment type / daily trip: UISS / code: By Resources / By Trip, Daily Trip, Trips per day. DB: No columns. Recommendation: DB change request
G-MKP-03 Grade thresholds: UISS / code: Fixed in code (master-kpi.js). DB: MS_KPI_PERCENTAGE (FROM / TO_PERCENTAGE -> VALUE). Recommendation: Read thresholds from MS_KPI_PERCENTAGE
